people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Meribah
people.line: A place where Moses disobeyed God

translations.web: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh, and he was sanctified in them.
translations.bsb: These were the waters of Meribah, where the Israelites quarreled with the LORD, and He showed His holiness among them.
translations.kjv: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified
translations.asv: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Jehovah, and he was sanctified in them.
